content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, kon nun siɑrɑ.
Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ kpɑ̃, ɑ ǹ nɔru mɔ.
Yɑm bururɑm kɑ yiiko yɑ nun wukiri.
A rɑ tii yɑm bururɑm wukiri nɡe bekuru.
A rɑ wɔllu tɛrie nɡe beku bɑkɑru.
Wunɛn wɑ̃ɑ yerɑ wɑ̃ɑ sere wɔllun nim wɔllɔ.
Mɑ ɡuru wirɑ sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn tɑbu kɛkɛ.
Mɑ ɑ bɛllimɔ wom wɔllɔ.
Mɑ ɑ woo kuɑ wunɛn ɡɔro.
Mɑ ɡuru mɑɑkinu kuɑ wunɛn sɔm kowobu.
A tem swĩi mɛn kpɛɛkpɛɛku wɔllɔ.
Mu ǹ wɔrumɑmɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
A derɑ nim mu mɛ wukiri sere kɑ ɡuunɔ nɡe beku bɑkɑru.
Adɑmɑ ye ɑ nim mɛ nɑruɑ, mɑ mu doonɑ.
Ye mu wunɛn ɡbɑ̃sukubu nuɑ, mu dukɑ suɑ,
mu sɑrɑ ɡuunun di, mu dɑ wɔwi sɔɔ sere mi ɑ mu ɑyeru kuɑ.
A nim mɛ yɔ̃rɑ yeru kuɑ mu ku rɑɑ kɑ sɑrɑ mu mɑɑ tem wukiri.
Wunɑ ɑ bwiin nim kpɑre mɛ mu kokumɔ ɡuunun bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Miyɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ kɑ ɡbeeku kɛtɛkunu nu rɑ nɛ nu nim nɔ.
Yen bɔkuɔrɑ ɡunɔsu su sin sokunu mɔ.
Mɑ su wɑ̃ɑ dɑ̃ɑ kikisɔ su swĩi dori mɔ̀.
Sɑɑ wɔllun di, ɑ rɑ de ɡurɑ yu ɡuunu swee,
kpɑ tem mu wunɛn sɔmɑn ɑre di.
Kpɑ ɑ de yɑkɑsu su kpi yɑɑ sɑbenun sɔ̃
kɑ dĩɑ ni tɔnu u koo din sɔ̃.
Kpɑ bu tɑm wɑ bɑ n kɑ nuku dobu mɔ̀.
Kpɑ bu ɡum wɑ ben wɑsi yi n kɑ wɑ̃.
Kpɑ bu dĩɑnu wɑ ben wɑsi yi n kɑ dɑm mɔ.
Bɑɑ kɑ dɑ̃ɑ koo bɑkɑnɔ, nu rɑ nim wɑ
mɛ̀n bukɑtɑ nu mɔ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛduru ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Libɑniɔ.
Miyɑ ɡunɔsu su rɑ nɛ su sin sokunu ko.
Miyɑ kpɑkpɑyɛ ɡbeeku ɡɑ rɑ ɡen wɑ̃ɑ yeru ko.
Guu ni nu ɡunu nu kuɑ kpee bɛrɑn wɑ̃ɑ yeru.
Mɑ kpee bɑɑ mɑɑ kuɑ yɑɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ dɑmɑɑn
wɑ̃ɑ yeru.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ suru kuɑ ɑ kɑ sɑɑbɑ wunɑnɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ u yɛ̃ sɑɑ ye u koo kpunɑ.
Yɑm wɔ̃kuru tɑ̀ n tunumɑ, yɑm tĩrɑwɑ mi.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ yi rɑ bɔsum se.
Gbee sinɑn piiminu nù n yɑɑ wɑ,
nu rɑ kukiriwɑ nu kɑ nun nin dĩɑnu bikiɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ ù n yɑrɑ, nu rɑ wurewɑ nin wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ nu kpunɑ.
Kpɑ tɔnu u mɑɑ yɑri u dɑ u win sɔmburu ko sere sɔ̃ɔ u kɑ du.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɛn sɔmɑ yɑ dɑbi.
A ye kpuro kuɑ kɑ lɑɑkɑri.
Wunɛn tɑkɑ koorɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem sɔɔ kpuro.
Wee nim wɔ̃ku ɡɑ kpɑ̃, ɡɑ mɑɑ yɑsu.
Ge sɔɔrɑ yɛɛ dɑbi dɑbinu wɑ̃ɑ, bɑkɑ kɑ buu.
Gen wɔllɔwɑ ɡoo nimkusu su sĩimɔ.
Miyɑ ɑ derɑ yɑɑ bɑkɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ
yɑ dweemɔ ɡen nim kurenu sɔɔ.
Yɛɛ kpuro, wunɛ turowɑ yi mɛɛrɑ
yi kɑ yin dĩɑnu wɑ nin sɑɑ sɔɔ.
À n yi wɛ̃ kpɑ yi mwɑ.
À n yi yɔ̃suɑ kpɑ yi debu.
À n yi biru kisi, yi rɑ nɑndewɑ.
À n yi wɛ̃siɑru wunɑri, yi ɡuwɑ mi,
kpɑ yi ɡɔsiɑ tem.
À n mɑɑ yi wɛ̃siɑru wɛ̃, yi rɑ sewɑ
kpɑ tem mu wurɑmɑ nɡe yellu.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɛn yiiko yu dɑkɑɑ dɑ.
Kpɑ ɑ n nuku dobu mɔ ye ɑ kuɑn sɔ̃.
À n tem mɛɛrɑ, mu rɑ yĩiriwɑ.
À n mɑɑ ɡuunu bɑbɑ, wiisɑ su rɑ yɑri.
Kon Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni womu kuɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ru kpuro sɔɔ.
Kon nùn tɔmɑ sere kɑ nɛn ɡɔɔn tɔ̃rɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ de nɛn ɡɑri yi nun dore.
Nɑ kĩ n nuku dobu ko wunɛ sɔɔ.
Durumɡibu bu ɡbio, kpɑ bɑ kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ.
Nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ kɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro.
I Yinni Gusunɔ siɑro.
